text: Atlas Real-Time Performance Panel correlates normalized CPU, system memory, disk IOPS utilization, and query shapes within 1-second metric resolution.
Disk IOPS throttling in AWS/Azure/GCP cloud environments manifests as sudden high execution latency accompanied by queuing WiredTiger disk checkpoints.
Scaling cluster instance size (e.g. M30 to M50) as a first response to unindexed query spikes without verifying ESR indexing wastes cloud budget and leaves bottleneck queries unoptimized.
In primary failover scenarios, verify Atlas election log lines to determine if the election was initiated by stepdown, heartbeat timeout, or out-of-memory kill.
Symptom: High memory usage alert (>90%). Cause: WiredTiger cache (50% RAM) plus connection overhead (1MB per thread) plus sorting buffers. Fix: Scale RAM or tune maxConns and allowDiskUse.
